assistiveTechnologyTests.procedure: Follow the documented procedure and listen for the information under test.

title: Client-side route change is not announced
description: The records browser replaces the view content in place. The alpha variant has an empty status region and never fills it, so nothing tells assistive-technology users that the content changed.

relatedElements.note: role=status with no text before or after the route change.
The control announces Showing about the records.

expectedBehaviour: A change of view that does not reload the page is announced, or focus moves to the new content.
actualBehaviour: The view changes silently; the status region stays empty and focus stays on the link.
userImpact: Screen-reader users may not realise that the page content has changed and continue reading the previous view's context.

detection.note: Requires a route change; the markup is valid before and after.

observed.note: Page-level axe run with tags wcag2a, wcag2aa, wcag21a, wcag21aa and best-practice. No violation was reported; the control on the same page also passes.

manualTests: Follow a link with a screen reader running and listen for an announcement or focus change.

assertions: The alpha status region stays empty after the route change.
tests: tests/responsive-and-state.spec.js: keeps the alpha page title and announcement stale

reviewStatus.note: A Playwright regression test preserves the defective behaviour and its control. That is automated reproduction, not a manual or assistive-technology observation.
